'''Shedren''' will be the clan chief of the [[Daryne]] Aiel seventeen years after the [[Last Battle]], seen by [[Aviendha]] in the [[Glass columns]] of [[Rhuidean]].

Shedren attends the meeting where the Aiel decide to go to war with the [[Seanchan]] and [[Padra]] thinks he is convinced by the decision.
